mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user advances while charging a blue Ki blast, then fires a single-hit tracking beam; when used closer to the target, the projectile fires sooner. Current dedicated documentation describes the skill as relatively quick and useful as a combo ender; exact startup, tracking parameters, and current damage remain unresolved.
